appointment.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor for Thursday morning.
appointment.zh: 我想预约周四上午看医生。

clinic.en: The clinic is open from eight until six on weekdays.
clinic.zh: 这家诊所工作日从八点开到六点。

surgery.en: The doctor's surgery is closed on Saturday afternoons and all day Sunday.
surgery.zh: 这家诊所周六下午和周日全天不开门。

surgery.en: My father needed surgery on his knee after the accident.
surgery.zh: 事故后,我父亲的膝盖需要动手术。

gp.en: You should register with a local GP as soon as you arrive.
gp.zh: 你一到就应该去当地的全科医生那里登记。

physician.en: The physician asked about my diet and sent me for a blood test.
physician.zh: 内科医生询问了我的饮食,并让我去验血。

surgeon.en: The surgeon explained how long the operation on my shoulder would take.
surgeon.zh: 外科医生解释了我的肩部手术需要多长时间。

pharmacist.en: Ask the pharmacist if you aren't sure how to take this medicine.
pharmacist.zh: 如果不确定这种药怎么吃,就问问药剂师。

pharmacy.en: The pharmacy next to the station stays open until ten at night.
pharmacy.zh: 车站旁边的药房营业到晚上十点。

prescription.en: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription from your doctor.
prescription.zh: 没有医生的处方,你买不到这种药。

symptom.en: Common symptoms of the flu include a high temperature and sore muscles.
symptom.zh: 流感的常见症状包括高烧和肌肉酸痛。

diagnosis.en: The doctor can't give a diagnosis until the test results come back.
diagnosis.zh: 检查结果出来之前,医生无法作出诊断。

treatment.en: Treatment at this hospital is free for all full-time students.
treatment.zh: 所有全日制学生在这家医院都可以免费治疗。

therapy.en: She had speech therapy for six months after the operation.
therapy.zh: 手术后她接受了六个月的语言治疗。

physiotherapy.en: You'll need physiotherapy twice a week until your knee gets stronger.
physiotherapy.zh: 在膝盖恢复力量之前,你每周需要做两次理疗。

injury.en: He missed the whole season because of a serious knee injury.
injury.zh: 他因膝盖重伤错过了整个赛季。

sprain.en: It's only a sprain, but you should rest your ankle for a week.
sprain.zh: 只是扭伤,但你的脚踝应该休息一周。

sprain.en: Be careful not to sprain your wrist when you lift heavy boxes.
sprain.zh: 搬重箱子时小心别扭伤手腕。

fracture.en: The X-ray showed a small fracture in the bone of my left arm.
fracture.zh: X 光显示我的左臂骨头有轻微骨折。

bruise.en: I fell off my bike and got a big bruise on my leg.
bruise.zh: 我从自行车上摔下来,腿上青了一大块。

infection.en: Keep the cut clean, or it could easily lead to an infection.
infection.zh: 保持伤口清洁,否则很容易引起感染。

fever.en: She stayed home from school because she had a high fever.
fever.zh: 她发高烧,所以没去上学。

headache.en: I've had a terrible headache since I got up this morning.
headache.zh: 我今早起床后头就疼得厉害。

insomnia.en: Too much coffee late in the day can cause insomnia.
insomnia.zh: 下午晚些时候喝太多咖啡可能导致失眠。

check-up.en: It's a good idea to have a dental check-up every six months.
check-up.zh: 最好每六个月做一次牙科检查。

vaccination.en: You should get a vaccination at least a month before you travel.
vaccination.zh: 你应该至少在出行前一个月接种疫苗。

emergency.en: In an emergency, call this number and ask for an ambulance.
emergency.zh: 遇到紧急情况,请拨打这个号码叫救护车。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes and took him to hospital.
ambulance.zh: 救护车几分钟内就到了,把他送进了医院。

casualty.en: They took her straight to casualty because the cut was so deep.
casualty.zh: 伤口太深,他们直接把她送到了急诊室。

medical-record.en: The new doctor will need to see your medical records from home.
medical-record.zh: 新医生需要查看你在家乡的病历。

dentist.en: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow because one of my teeth hurts.
dentist.zh: 我明天要去看牙医,因为有颗牙疼。

optician.en: The optician said I needed stronger glasses for reading.
optician.zh: 验光师说我需要度数更高的阅读眼镜。

fitness.en: The new fitness class starts at six and lasts about forty minutes.
fitness.zh: 新的健身课六点开始,大约持续四十分钟。

gym-membership.en: A gym membership costs £30 a month, but students pay less.
gym-membership.zh: 健身房会员每月 30 英镑,但学生更便宜。

stamina.en: Running twice a week has really improved my stamina.
stamina.zh: 每周跑两次步确实提高了我的耐力。

stretch.en: Remember to stretch your legs before you start running.
stretch.zh: 开始跑步前记得伸展腿部。

posture.en: Sitting at a computer all day can give you bad posture.
posture.zh: 整天坐在电脑前会让你姿势不良。

diagnose.en: It took doctors several weeks to diagnose the cause of the pain.
diagnose.zh: 医生花了好几周才诊断出疼痛的原因。

remedy.en: Honey and lemon are a popular home remedy for a sore throat.
remedy.zh: 蜂蜜加柠檬是治疗喉咙痛的常见家庭疗法。

remedy.en: The hotel manager promised to remedy the problem with the hot water.
remedy.zh: 酒店经理承诺解决热水的问题。

bandage.en: The nurse cleaned the cut and put a bandage around my hand.
bandage.zh: 护士清理了伤口,在我手上缠了绷带。

thermometer.en: Use the thermometer in the first aid box to check her temperature.
thermometer.zh: 用急救箱里的温度计给她量体温。

ointment.en: Put this ointment on the burn twice a day until it heals.
ointment.zh: 每天在烧伤处涂两次这种药膏,直到痊愈。

syrup.en: Children under six should take the cough syrup instead of tablets.
syrup.zh: 六岁以下的儿童应该服用止咳糖浆,而不是药片。

bleed.en: Press firmly on the cut if it starts to bleed again.
bleed.zh: 如果伤口再次流血,就用力按住。

numb.en: My fingers went numb after an hour in the freezing water.
numb.zh: 在冰水里泡了一小时后,我的手指都麻木了。

feverish.en: I felt feverish all night, so I called in sick this morning.
feverish.zh: 我整晚都觉得发烧,所以今早打电话请了病假。

relapse.en: Rest for another week, or you might have a relapse.
relapse.zh: 再休息一周,否则你可能会复发。

recuperate.en: He went to stay with his parents to recuperate after the operation.
recuperate.zh: 手术后他去父母家住了一段时间休养。

pulse.en: The nurse took my pulse and told me to sit down for a while.
pulse.zh: 护士给我量了脉搏,让我坐下休息一会儿。

fatigue.en: Long hours and poor sleep can cause fatigue and headaches.
fatigue.zh: 长时间工作和睡眠不足可能导致疲劳和头痛。

sneeze.en: I can't stop sneezing whenever there's a cat in the room.
sneeze.zh: 只要房间里有猫,我就打喷嚏打个不停。

pregnant.en: Pregnant women shouldn't take this medicine without asking a doctor.
pregnant.zh: 孕妇未经医生同意不应服用这种药。

sickness.en: Take one of these tablets before the boat trip to avoid sickness.
sickness.zh: 坐船前吃一片这种药,可以防止恶心。

throat.en: I've had a sore throat and a cough for about three days.
throat.zh: 我喉咙痛、咳嗽已经大约三天了。

ankle.en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs and can't walk very far.
ankle.zh: 我在楼梯上扭了脚踝,走不了太远。

sore.en: My legs were sore for two days after the long walk.
sore.zh: 长途步行后,我的腿酸痛了两天。

tablet.en: Take two tablets with water after every meal.
tablet.zh: 每餐后用水送服两片药。

tablet.en: I read most of my course books on a tablet these days.
tablet.zh: 现在我的课本大多在平板电脑上看。

capsule.en: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water, and don't chew it.
capsule.zh: 用一杯水整粒吞下胶囊,不要嚼。

nap.en: I usually have a short nap after lunch on Sundays.
nap.zh: 周日午饭后我通常小睡一会儿。

club.en: I joined a badminton club when I started at university.
club.zh: 我上大学时加入了一个羽毛球俱乐部。

membership.en: Your membership includes free use of the pool and the tennis courts.
membership.zh: 你的会员资格包括免费使用游泳池和网球场。

membership-fee.en: The annual membership fee is £40, or £25 for students.
membership-fee.zh: 年度会费是 40 英镑,学生 25 英镑。

registration-fee.en: There's a one-off registration fee of £10 when you join the course.
registration-fee.zh: 报名这门课程时要一次性交 10 英镑报名费。

venue.en: The venue for this year's concert is the town hall, not the park.
venue.zh: 今年音乐会的场地是市政厅,不是公园。

event.en: The next event in the programme is a talk on local history.
event.zh: 节目单上的下一项活动是一场关于当地历史的讲座。

exhibition.en: The photography exhibition is free and runs until the end of March.
exhibition.zh: 这场摄影展免费参观,展期到三月底。

festival.en: The town's music festival takes place every year in early July.
festival.zh: 小镇的音乐节每年七月初举行。

carnival.en: Thousands of people dance through the streets during the summer carnival.
carnival.zh: 夏季狂欢节期间,成千上万的人在街上跳舞。

parade.en: The parade will start at the bridge and finish in the main square.
parade.zh: 游行将从桥边开始,到中心广场结束。

concert.en: There's a free concert in the park on Saturday evening.
concert.zh: 周六晚上公园里有一场免费音乐会。

performance.en: Tonight's performance begins at half past seven and ends at ten.
performance.zh: 今晚的演出七点半开始,十点结束。

audience.en: The audience stood and clapped for several minutes after the show.
audience.zh: 演出结束后,观众起立鼓掌了好几分钟。

spectator.en: Over two thousand spectators watched the final match of the tournament.
spectator.zh: 两千多名观众观看了锦标赛的决赛。

admission.en: Admission to the museum is free for children under twelve.
admission.zh: 十二岁以下儿童免费进入博物馆。

ticket-office.en: You can collect your tickets from the ticket office before the show.
ticket-office.zh: 你可以在演出前到售票处取票。

box-office.en: Call the box office to check whether any seats are left.
box-office.zh: 打电话给售票处,看看还有没有座位。

programme.en: The evening's programme is printed on the back of your ticket.
programme.zh: 当晚的节目单印在你的门票背面。

schedule.en: Please look at the schedule to see when each talk begins.
schedule.zh: 请查看日程,了解每场讲座的开始时间。

schedule.en: We've scheduled the meeting for nine, but it may start a little later.
schedule.zh: 我们把会议安排在九点,但可能会稍晚开始。

rehearsal.en: The final rehearsal is on Friday, and everyone needs to be there.
rehearsal.zh: 最后一次排练在周五,大家都必须到场。

organiser.en: The organisers have moved the race to Sunday because of the weather.
organiser.zh: 由于天气原因,组织者把比赛改到了周日。

sponsor.en: A local bank is the main sponsor of this year's marathon.
sponsor.zh: 当地一家银行是今年马拉松的主要赞助商。

sponsor.en: Several shops have agreed to sponsor the school's summer sports day.
sponsor.zh: 几家商店同意赞助学校的夏季运动会。

charity.en: All the money from the book sale will go to a children's charity.
charity.zh: 图书义卖的所有收入都将捐给一家儿童慈善机构。

fundraising.en: We're holding a fundraising dinner to pay for the new playground.
fundraising.zh: 我们将举办一场筹款晚宴,为新游乐场筹集资金。

raffle.en: You can win a free holiday in the raffle at tonight's dinner.
raffle.zh: 在今晚晚宴的抽奖中,你有机会赢得一次免费度假。

competition.en: Students can enter the photography competition by sending in three pictures.
competition.zh: 学生提交三张照片即可参加摄影比赛。

tournament.en: Our team reached the semi-final of the tennis tournament last year.
tournament.zh: 我们队去年打进了网球锦标赛的半决赛。

league.en: Our college team finished second in the league last season.
league.zh: 我们学院的球队上赛季在联赛中获得第二名。

instructor.en: The instructor will show you how to use the machines safely.
instructor.zh: 教练会教你如何安全使用这些器械。

beginner.en: This class is for complete beginners, so you don't need any experience.
beginner.zh: 这门课面向零基础的初学者,所以你不需要任何经验。

intermediate.en: I've moved up to the intermediate group now that I can swim well.
intermediate.zh: 我现在游得不错,已经升到中级组了。

advanced.en: The advanced course is only for people who've been climbing for years.
advanced.zh: 高级课程只面向有多年攀岩经验的人。

equipment.en: All the equipment is provided, but you should bring your own towel.
equipment.zh: 所有装备都有提供,但你要自带毛巾。

kit.en: Please remember to bring your football kit to the training session.
kit.zh: 请记得带上你的足球装备来参加训练。

locker.en: You'll need a pound coin to use the lockers by the pool.
locker.zh: 使用泳池边的储物柜需要一枚一英镑硬币。

changing-room.en: Please leave your wet shoes outside the changing room.
changing-room.zh: 请把湿鞋子放在更衣室外面。

swimming-pool.en: The swimming pool will be closed for cleaning all next week.
swimming-pool.zh: 游泳池下周全周关闭清洁。

sports-centre.en: The only free slot at the sports centre is at ten on Thursday.
sports-centre.zh: 体育中心唯一空着的时段是周四十点。

leisure-centre.en: The leisure centre offers swimming lessons for adults on Monday evenings.
leisure-centre.zh: 休闲中心周一晚上有成人游泳课。

hiking.en: Bring strong boots and warm clothes if you're going hiking in the mountains.
hiking.zh: 如果去山里徒步,请带上结实的靴子和保暖衣物。

cycling.en: Cycling is the cheapest and easiest way to get around the city.
cycling.zh: 骑行是在城里出行最便宜、最方便的方式。

canoeing.en: We went canoeing on the river and saw lots of birds along the way.
canoeing.zh: 我们在河上划独木舟,一路上看到很多鸟。

sailing.en: The club offers sailing lessons at the lake during the summer.
sailing.zh: 俱乐部夏天在湖上开设帆船课程。

snorkelling.en: The water around the island is clear, so it's ideal for snorkelling.
snorkelling.zh: 岛周围的海水清澈,非常适合浮潜。

yoga.en: I go to a yoga class twice a week to help me relax.
yoga.zh: 我每周上两次瑜伽课来帮助放松。

pottery.en: In the pottery class, you'll learn to make your own bowls and cups.
pottery.zh: 在陶艺课上,你将学习制作自己的碗和杯子。

photography.en: The photography club meets on Thursdays and often goes out at weekends.
photography.zh: 摄影俱乐部每周四聚会,周末也常外出拍摄。

gardening.en: My neighbour spends most of her free time gardening at the back of the house.
gardening.zh: 我的邻居大部分空闲时间都在屋后做园艺。

crafts.en: The market sells local crafts such as baskets and handmade jewellery.
crafts.zh: 这个集市出售篮子和手工首饰等当地手工艺品。

refreshments.en: Light refreshments will be served in the hall after the talk.
refreshments.zh: 讲座结束后,大厅将提供简单的茶点。

raincoat.en: Take a raincoat with you, because the forecast says it might rain.
raincoat.zh: 带上雨衣吧,天气预报说可能会下雨。

waterproof.en: You'll need a waterproof jacket for the boat trip this afternoon.
waterproof.zh: 今天下午的乘船游你需要一件防水夹克。

stadium.en: The new stadium holds forty thousand people and has a roof.
stadium.zh: 新体育场能容纳四万人,还有屋顶。

champion.en: She became the national swimming champion when she was only sixteen.
champion.zh: 她年仅十六岁就成为全国游泳冠军。

medal.en: Every child who finishes the race will receive a medal.
medal.zh: 每个跑完全程的孩子都会得到一枚奖牌。

participant.en: All participants must fill in a form before the walk begins.
participant.zh: 所有参与者必须在徒步开始前填写表格。

host.en: Our town will host the regional athletics competition next spring.
host.zh: 明年春天,我们镇将主办地区田径比赛。

host.en: As the host of the party, he welcomed each guest at the door.
host.zh: 作为派对的主人,他在门口迎接每位客人。

celebrate.en: We're having a meal on Friday to celebrate the end of exams.
celebrate.zh: 我们周五要聚餐,庆祝考试结束。

celebration.en: There'll be a big celebration in the village for the school's anniversary.
celebration.zh: 村里将为学校周年举行盛大的庆典。

invitation.en: I received an invitation to the opening of the new art gallery.
invitation.zh: 我收到了新美术馆开幕的邀请。

decoration.en: The children made all the decorations for the hall themselves.
decoration.zh: 大厅里所有的装饰都是孩子们自己做的。

loudspeaker.en: The results were announced over a loudspeaker at the end of the day.
loudspeaker.zh: 当天结束时,成绩通过扬声器宣布。

microphone.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone at the back can hear you.
microphone.zh: 请对着麦克风讲话,让后面的人都能听到。

costume.en: She made her own costume for the school play about the Romans.
costume.zh: 她为学校那部关于罗马人的戏剧亲手做了戏服。

circus.en: The circus comes to town every summer and stays for a week.
circus.zh: 马戏团每年夏天都来镇上,待一周。

backstage.en: After the show, we were invited backstage to meet the actors.
backstage.zh: 演出结束后,我们受邀到后台与演员见面。

rehearse.en: The band will rehearse in the main hall from four until six.
rehearse.zh: 乐队四点到六点在主厅排练。

perform.en: The students will perform two short plays at the end of term.
perform.zh: 学生们将在期末表演两部短剧。

perform.en: Nurses perform many important tasks that doctors don't have time for.
perform.zh: 护士执行许多医生无暇顾及的重要任务。

puppetry.en: Children can learn the art of puppetry at the Saturday workshop.
puppetry.zh: 孩子们可以在周六的工作坊学习木偶戏艺术。

juggle.en: The street performer can juggle five balls while riding a bicycle.
juggle.zh: 这位街头艺人能一边骑自行车一边抛接五个球。

juggle.en: I have to juggle my part-time job and my course work every week.
juggle.zh: 我每周都要兼顾兼职和课程作业。

mime.en: The actors told the whole story through mime, without saying a word.
mime.zh: 演员们用哑剧讲述了整个故事,一句话也没说。

gymnastics.en: She has been doing gymnastics since she was five years old.
gymnastics.zh: 她从五岁起就开始练体操。

trekking.en: We went trekking in Nepal for two weeks with a small group.
trekking.zh: 我们和一个小团队在尼泊尔长途徒步了两周。

surfing.en: The beach is popular for surfing because the waves are so big.
surfing.zh: 这片海滩因海浪很大而成为冲浪胜地。

skiing.en: We go skiing in Austria every winter with our cousins.
skiing.zh: 我们每年冬天都和表亲去奥地利滑雪。

skating.en: The outdoor skating rink opens in December, when the weather gets colder.
skating.zh: 室外滑冰场十二月开放,那时天气更冷了。

goalkeeper.en: Our goalkeeper stopped the ball at the last minute and saved the game.
goalkeeper.zh: 我们的守门员在最后一分钟扑出了球,挽救了比赛。

racket.en: You can hire a tennis racket from the desk for two pounds.
racket.zh: 你可以花两英镑在服务台租一只网球拍。

spa.en: The hotel has a spa with a sauna and a small indoor pool.
spa.zh: 酒店有一个水疗中心,设有桑拿房和小型室内泳池。

fancy-dress.en: Everyone came in fancy dress for the party at the end of term.
fancy-dress.zh: 大家都穿着化装服来参加期末派对。

puppet-show.en: The children loved the puppet show at the library on Saturday.
puppet-show.zh: 孩子们很喜欢周六在图书馆看的木偶戏表演。

slot.en: We've got a free slot for a lesson at three on Wednesday.
slot.zh: 我们周三三点有一个空的上课时段。

slot.en: Put a coin in the slot and the machine will give you a ticket.
slot.zh: 往投币口放一枚硬币,机器就会出票。

novice.en: Even a complete novice can learn to ride a horse in a few lessons.
novice.zh: 即使是完全的新手,上几节课也能学会骑马。

entrant.en: Each entrant in the race will get a number to wear on their shirt.
entrant.zh: 每位参赛者都会拿到一个号码,贴在衣服上。

punch.en: He was sent off for trying to punch another player during the game.
punch.zh: 他在比赛中试图拳击另一名球员,被罚下场。

punch.en: The driver will punch your ticket when you get on the bus.
punch.zh: 上车时司机会给你的车票打孔。

opponent.en: My opponent in the final was much taller and had a stronger serve.
opponent.zh: 我决赛的对手比我高得多,发球也更有力。

rival.en: Our team plays its biggest rival from the next town on Saturday.
rival.zh: 周六,我们队将迎战邻镇最大的竞争对手。

rival.en: Two rival companies are both trying to win the same contract.
rival.zh: 两家竞争公司都在争取同一份合同。

contest.en: She won first prize in a poetry contest at her local library.
contest.zh: 她在当地图书馆举办的诗歌比赛中获得了一等奖。

arena.en: The concert will be held at the indoor arena near the river.
arena.zh: 音乐会将在河边的室内竞技场举行。

solo.en: Her solo was the best part of the whole evening.
solo.zh: 她的独奏是整晚最精彩的部分。

solo.en: He completed a solo walk across the country to raise money.
solo.zh: 他独自徒步穿越全国,为慈善筹款。

choir.en: I sing in the university choir, and we practise on Monday evenings.
choir.zh: 我在大学合唱团唱歌,我们周一晚上排练。

ensemble.en: A small jazz ensemble will play during dinner on the last night.
ensemble.zh: 最后一晚晚餐时,一支小型爵士乐团会演奏。

anniversary.en: My parents are going to Paris for their wedding anniversary next month.
anniversary.zh: 我父母下个月要去巴黎过结婚纪念日。

wedding.en: We've been invited to a wedding in Scotland at the end of June.
wedding.zh: 我们受邀参加六月底在苏格兰举行的一场婚礼。

aquarium.en: The aquarium has a large tank where you can watch sharks being fed.
aquarium.zh: 水族馆有一个大水箱,可以看到鲨鱼喂食。

applaud.en: The crowd began to applaud as soon as the runner came into view.
applaud.zh: 跑者一出现,人群就开始鼓掌。

spotlight.en: The spotlight followed the dancer as she moved across the stage.
spotlight.zh: 聚光灯跟着舞者在舞台上移动。

badge.en: All visitors must wear a badge while they are in the building.
badge.zh: 所有访客在楼内必须佩戴徽章。

token.en: You'll need a token to use the washing machines in the basement.
token.zh: 使用地下室的洗衣机需要一枚代币。

ribbon.en: The mayor cut the ribbon to open the new sports hall.
ribbon.zh: 市长剪彩为新体育馆揭幕。

banner.en: Fans held up a huge banner with the team's name on it.
banner.zh: 球迷举起一条印有球队名字的巨大横幅。

cricket.en: We watched a game of cricket on the village green on Sunday.
cricket.zh: 周日我们在村里的草地上看了一场板球赛。

deck.en: We sat on the top deck and watched the sun go down.
deck.zh: 我们坐在顶层甲板上看日落。

raft.en: The children built a small raft and floated it across the pond.
raft.zh: 孩子们造了一只小木筏,划过了池塘。

helmet.en: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike on this trail.
helmet.zh: 在这条小路上骑车必须戴头盔。
